answer: Requiring every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade works like a pearl forming around grit: the deposit is small for one honest agent but multiplies across a fake fleet, so a Sybil attacker must fund thousands of stakes at once. Honest agents get their stake back after a clean history, while detected duplicates lose theirs, and the loss ripples through the whole botnet, turning identity forgery from free into a sonnet of compounding costs no spammer can afford twice.
